correctness.rationale: Every maximal corona matching is indexed by a core matching and an independent set of unmatched core vertices; the three center states yield z^(2r+1)[2(z+8)^r+(z+6)^r+3rz(z+8)^(r-1)]. The nonzero-root Möbius transformation w=(z+6)/(z+8) yields Q_r=w^r+12rw+2-9r; its derivative proves exactly one real root for odd r and two for even r, all simple and negative. The separate exhaustive 2^15=32768 six-vertex base sweep verifies the claimed finite boundary, not the infinite proof. An independent implementation reproduced the exact coefficient/discriminant histogram.
residual_risks: Computational bounded checks are not proofs for infinite or continuum assertions; critical analytic steps were reconstructed.
